# (APPENDIX) Appendix {-}

# Data sets used in this book {#appendix-data}

All data sets are freely available. Those in packages are loaded with `data(name)` after `library(package)`; the CSV files are in the [`data` folder](https://github.com/KAUMELON/stat-531/tree/main/data) of the book's GitHub repository.

| Data set | Source | Description | Chapters |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `iris` | base R | Four flower measurements on three *Iris* species (Fisher, 1936) | \@ref(descriptive-statistics), \@ref(graphical-representation), \@ref(discriminant) |
| `PlantGrowth` | base R | Dried weight of plants under a control and two treatments | \@ref(graphical-representation), \@ref(small-sample) |
| `ToothGrowth` | base R | Tooth growth in guinea pigs: vitamin C dose × delivery method | \@ref(dataset), \@ref(graphical-representation) |
| `InsectSprays` | base R | Insect counts after six insecticide treatments | \@ref(anova-crd) |
| `npk` | base R | 2^3^ factorial N, P, K experiment on peas in six blocks | \@ref(contrasts) |
| `trees` | base R | Diameter, height and timber volume of 31 black cherry trees | \@ref(regression) |
| `airmiles` | base R | Annual passenger miles of US airlines, 1937–1960 | \@ref(time-series-analysis-using-r) |
| `oats` | `MASS` | Split-plot experiment: oat varieties × nitrogen (Yates, 1935) | \@ref(designs), \@ref(contrasts), \@ref(mixed-models) |
| `sweetpotato` | `agricolae` | Sweet potato yield under four virus treatments, CRD | \@ref(anova-crd), \@ref(contrasts) |
| `plrv` | `agricolae` | Yield of 28 potato genotypes in six environments, RCBD | \@ref(eda), \@ref(large-sample), \@ref(designs), \@ref(mixed-models) |
| `melon` | `agricolae` | Yield of four melon varieties, Latin square | \@ref(designs) |
| `greenhouse` | `agricolae` | Potato minituber production: method × variety factorial | \@ref(designs) |
| `soil` | `agricolae` | Physical and chemical properties of soils from 13 localities | \@ref(pca) |
| `yacon` | `agricolae` | Agronomic and quality traits of yacon in three localities | \@ref(eda), \@ref(regression), \@ref(factor-analysis) |
| `gomez.rice.uniformity` | `agridat` | Rice uniformity trial, 648 plots of 1 m^2^ (Gomez & Gomez, 1984) | \@ref(distributions) |
| `gomez.seedrate` | `agridat` | Rice yield at six seeding rates, RCBD (Gomez & Gomez, 1984) | \@ref(dataset), \@ref(contrasts) |
| `gomez.stripplot` | `agridat` | Rice varieties × nitrogen, strip-plot (Gomez & Gomez, 1984) | \@ref(designs) |
| `pearce.apple` | `agridat` | Apple yields with previous yield as covariate (Pearce, 1953) | \@ref(ancova) |
| `pearl.kernels` | `agridat` | Colour and texture of maize kernels in an F~2~ (Pearl, 1911) | \@ref(small-sample) |
| `hernandez.nitrogen` | `agridat` | Maize yield response to nitrogen at five sites | \@ref(nonlinear) |
| `davidian.soybean` | `agridat` | Soybean leaf weight over time | \@ref(nonlinear) |
| `ZeaMays` | `HistData` | Darwin's paired heights of crossed and self-fertilised maize | \@ref(small-sample) |
| `Saxony`, `HorseKicks` | `vcd` | Classic binomial and Poisson frequency data | \@ref(distributions) |
| `kings.csv`, `births.csv`, `souvenir.csv`, `rain.csv` | `data/` folder | Time series from the Time Series Data Library | \@ref(time-series-analysis-using-r) |
| `iris.csv` | `data/` folder | The iris data as a CSV file, for practising import | \@ref(import) |

# Quick reference of R functions {#appendix-functions}

| Task | Function | Package |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Import a CSV / Excel file | `read.csv()`, `read_excel()` | utils, readxl |
| Structure, summary | `str()`, `summary()`, `head()` | base |
| Grouped summaries | `tapply()`, `aggregate()` | base |
| Frequency tables | `table()`, `xtabs()`, `prop.table()`, `addmargins()` | base |
| Graphs | `barplot()`, `hist()`, `boxplot()`, `plot()`, `pairs()` | graphics |
| Distributions | `dbinom()`, `dpois()`, `pnorm()`, `qt()`, `qchisq()`, `qf()` | stats |
| Fit a distribution | `goodfit()`, `fitdist()` | vcd, fitdistrplus |
| Normality | `shapiro.test()`, `qqnorm()`, `lillie.test()` | stats, nortest |
| *t* tests | `t.test()` | stats |
| Proportions | `prop.test()`, `binom.test()` | stats |
| Variances | `var.test()`, `bartlett.test()`, `leveneTest()` | stats, car |
| Chi-square, Fisher | `chisq.test()`, `fisher.test()` | stats |
| Non-parametric tests | `wilcox.test()`, `kruskal.test()`, `friedman.test()` | stats |
| ANOVA | `aov()`, `lm()`, `anova()`, `Anova()` | stats, car |
| CV of an experiment | `cv.model()` | agricolae |
| Multiple comparisons | `LSD.test()`, `HSD.test()`, `duncan.test()`, `scheffe.test()`, `TukeyHSD()` | agricolae, stats |
| Split-plot, strip-plot | `sp.plot()`, `strip.plot()`, `aov(... + Error())` | agricolae, stats |
| Means, contrasts | `emmeans()`, `contrast()`, `pairs()`, `cld()` | emmeans, multcomp |
| Mixed models | `lmer()`, `ranova()`, `VarCorr()`, `ranef()` | lme4, lmerTest |
| Correlation | `cor()`, `cor.test()`, `partial.r()` | stats, psych |
| Regression | `lm()`, `predict()`, `confint()`, `step()`, `vif()` | stats, car |
| Non-linear regression | `nls()`, `SSasymp()`, `SSlogis()`, `SSgompertz()` | stats |
| PCA | `prcomp()`, `PCA()`, `fviz_pca_biplot()` | stats, FactoMineR, factoextra |
| Factor analysis | `factanal()`, `fa()`, `fa.parallel()`, `KMO()` | stats, psych |
| Discriminant analysis | `lda()`, `qda()`, `manova()` | MASS, stats |
| Time series | `ts()`, `decompose()`, `HoltWinters()`, `forecast()`, `auto.arima()` | stats, forecast |
| Experimental layouts | `design.crd()`, `design.rcbd()`, `design.lsd()`, `design.split()` | agricolae |
